content: आ The second letter of the Alphabet.

आ .²1 Used as a particle or interjection showing .³({%a%}) assent; ‘yes’, ‘verily’. .³({%b%}) Compassion (अनुकम्पा) ‘Ah’. .³({%c%}) Pain or regret (usually written आस् or अः <ab>q. v.</ab>), ‘alas’. .³({%d%}) Recollection (स्मरण). ‘Ah’, ‘Oh’; आ एवं किलासीत् <ls>U. 6</ls>. .³({%e%}) But (used as a disjunctive conjunction). .³({%f%}) And (used as a cumulative conjunction). .³({%g%}) Sometimes used as an expletive; आ एवं मन्यसे. In all these senses आ is treated as a Pragṛhya vowel (does not form any Sandhi with a following vowel) <ls>P. I. 1. 14</ls>. .³({%h%}) It shows ‘anger’ also. .²2 (As a prefix to verbs and nouns.) .³({%a%}) it expresses the senses of near, near to, towards, from all sides, all around (see the several verbs). .³({%b%}) With verbs of motion, taking, carrying <ab>&c.</ab> it shows the reverse of the action; as गम् to go, आगम् to come; दा to give, आदा to take; नी to carry, आनी to bring. .²3 (As a separable preposition with <ab>abl.</ab>) it shows either .³({%a%}) the limit inceptive (अभिविधि), from, ever since, away from, out of, off, from among; आ मूलात् श्रोतुमिच्छामि <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; बहुभ्य आ from out of many; आ जन्मनः <ls>Ś. 5. 25</ls> ever since (her) birth; आ मनोः <ls>U. 6. 18</ls>. .³({%b%}) Or, it expresses the limit exclusive or conclusive (मर्यादा), till, until, upto, as far as, unto; आड् मर्यादाभिविध्योः <ls>P. II. 1. 13</ls>; see अभिविधि; आ परितोषाद्विदुषाम् <ls>Ś. 1. 2</ls> till the learned are satisfied; आ कैलासात् <ls>Me. 11</ls> upto or as far as Kailāsa; ओदकान्तात् <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; <ls>U. 1. 37</ls>; <ls>V. 2. 2</ls>. In this sense आ sometimes governs the <ab>acc.</ab>; शतमा जातीः upto a hundred births. .³({%c%}) In both these senses आ frequently enters into compound, forming either Avyayībhāva <ab>comp.</ab> or compound adjectives; आबालं (or आ बालेभ्यः) हरिभक्तिः commencing with or including children; आमुक्ति (or आ मुक्तेः) संसारः <ls>Sk.</ls> till final emancipation; आमेखलम् <ls>Ku. 1. 5</ls> as far as; आमरणम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls> till death; आगोपालं ननृतुः <ls>K. 70</ls> down to the cowherd; आगोपाला द्विजातयः including the cowherds. Sometimes the compound so formed stands as the first member of other compounds, सोऽहमाजन्मशुद्धानामाफलोदयकर्मणाम् . आसमुद्रक्षितीशानामानाकरथवर्त्मनाम् <ls>R. 1. 5</ls>; आगण्डविलम्बि <ls>Ś. 6. 17</ls>; आकर्णलम्बि <ls>M. 5. 10</ls>. .³({%d%}) Used with <ab>loc.</ab> it has the sense of ‘in’, ‘at’ (mostly <ab>Ved.</ab>); गावो न यवसेष्वा <ls>Rv. 1. 91. 13</ls>. .²4 With adjectives (or sometimes with nouns) आ has a diminutive force; आपिञ्जर {%a.%} Little red, reddish; आपिञ्जरा बद्धरजःकणत्वान्मञ्जर्युदारा शुशुभेऽर्जुनस्य <ls>R. 16. 51</ls>; आपाण्डुर a little white, whitish; आलक्ष्य <ls>Ś. 7. 18</ls> slightly visible; आकम्पः gentle shaking; so आनील, आरक्त. .²5 (As a separable adverb) आ chiefly occurs in the Vedas and means near, near to, or towards, there to, further; and also, even; in many cases it emphasizes the word which precedes it, and when placed after prepositions it strengthens their sense. आ प्रगृह्ये स्मृतौ वाक्ये परितापे पितामहे . घटे भावे च आऽस्तु स्यादव्ययं कोपपीडयोः . आङीषदर्थेऽभिव्याप्तौ सीमार्थे धातुयोगजे .. <ls>Nm.</ls>
